Container.Name: stationplay
Container.Overview: tapiOca makes custom, always-on TV stations from your own movies and shows, with a program guide: from your own Plex Media Server, from folders of your own, or both. Plex's terms license Plex Media Server for personal use, on hardware and storage you own. Watch in Plex (with Plex Pass), Jellyfin, Emby, Kodi, tapiOca's own apps and other apps on your home network. Self-hosted, free and open source (GNU AGPL v3). tapiOca is in beta: for testing only.
Container.Requires: Your own movies and shows, in Plex Media Server or in folders of your own. The data folder must belong to the user in Extra Parameters (99:100 to start): chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/stationplay/data

Config.Name: Port for Plex and your home network
Config.Description: Plex, other apps and your home network. Never forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: Port for the page from the internet
Config.Description: tapiOca's page and apps from the internet, through a reverse proxy or a Cloudflare Tunnel (README: Security and remote access). Plex's addresses aren't on it, and signing in is always required. Remove it if you don't need that, and remove PUBLIC_PORT too.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Stations, settings, logos, the Broken files list and backups. It must belong to the user tapiOca runs as (99:100 to start).

Config.Name: Media folder
Config.Description: Your media folder, read-only, such as /mnt/user/media. tapiOca matches the paths Plex reports to this folder automatically.

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Your Plex server's address, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Use its network IP address, not localhost. No Plex? Leave it empty, and add Media folders of your own on tapiOca's page.

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your Plex token (README: Finding your Plex token). Keep it private: it gives full access to your Plex server. No Plex? Leave it empty.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your time zone, such as America/Chicago.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_PORT
Config.Description: The port for tapiOca's page and apps from the internet, inside the container. It must differ from 3310. Remove it if you remove that port.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: The port for Plex and your home network, inside the container. Leave it as 3310.

Config.Name: MEDIA_DIR
Config.Description: Where your media is, inside the container. Leave it as /media.

Config.Name: HW_ACCEL
Config.Description: auto = use a GPU if one passes a test encode, otherwise the CPU. Other values: intel, amd, nvidia, cpu.

Config.Name: TAPIOCA_INSTALL
Config.Description: How the page says to update (README: Updating). Leave it as unraid.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Intel or AMD graphics (such as Quick Sync), for GPU encoding: set it to /dev/dri if the server has it (check with: ls -ln /dev/dri). If the Video encoding line on tapiOca's Setup tab names a group, add --group-add and that number to Extra Parameters.
